about: Built by tools/build_constitution.py. The Navy Yard is traced from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) on aerial imagery and turned so Pier 1 runs left to right (up is north-east). The museum is its own 2024 visitor map, drawn about twice life size; the names of its rooms follow the exhibits it lists in 2026. The ship is a diagram of the three decks visitors see, drawn large. Which Pier 1 building is the Navy’s security screening is a guess.
source: USS Constitution Museum visitor map (social narrative, 2024); OpenStreetMap; Esri World Imagery
units: Esri World Imagery pixels at zoom 19 (about 0.22 m), turned 33.7°; the museum and the ship are diagrams drawn larger
